transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Arjun, I'm calling because my internet connection has been dropping constantly for the last three days. It's incredibly frustrating.
Agent: I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing these connectivity issues. I can certainly look into this for you.
Agent: Before we dive into the account details, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: Yes, it's 85980310. My name is Vivek Sharma.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Sharma. I see your account is active. Let me check the network status in your area.
Customer: I've already tried restarting the router several times. It's just not working and I'm paying for a service I'm not working.
Agent: I've checked the system and there is a network instability in your neighborhood. I will raise a network ticket to have our engineers investigate the fault.
Customer: A ticket? I'm tired of this. I just want to cancel my service entirely and switch to another provider who actually works.
Agent: I understand your frustration, but I can help you process the cancellation request for your account now.
Customer: Just do it. I'm done with Nimbus Telecom. This is the worst service I've ever had.
Agent: I have initiated the request. However, since this is a cancellation, I need to escalate this to our loyalty team for final approval. They will contact you at 96775 44838 or vivek.21@examplemail.com.
Customer: This is ridiculous! Why can't you just cancel it right now? I'm absolutely disgusted with this company!
Agent: I apologize, but the process requires a supervisor's review. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? I've raised the network ticket and sent the request to the loyalty team. Goodbye.
